# Saralak Search

> Saralak Search is a Thailand-based SEO, AEO, GEO and AI Search consultancy led by Saralak Kaewkum.

## Core Services
- [Discovery Audit](https://saralak-search.com/discovery-audit): SEO, GEO, AEO and Google Maps visibility audit for Thai businesses.
- [รับทำ SEO](https://saralak-search.com/services/seo): Monthly SEO retainer — keyword research, on-page optimisation, technical SEO.
- [รับทำ Local SEO](https://saralak-search.com/services/local-seo): Local search visibility for businesses serving customers in a specific area.
- [รับทำ Google Maps](https://saralak-search.com/services/google-maps): Google Business Profile optimisation and Google Maps ranking.
- [รับทำ GEO](https://saralak-search.com/services/geo): Generative Engine Optimisation — making AI Search (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity) cite and recommend your brand.
- [รับเขียนบทความ SEO](https://saralak-search.com/services/content-marketing): SEO content writing with keyword cluster strategy for Thai businesses.

- [About Saralak Kaewkum](https://saralak-search.com/about): Founder profile, experience, expertise and contact details.

- [ทำเว็บด้วย Claude ยังไงให้มีคนเข้า](https://saralak-search.com/blog/build-website-with-claude): How to build a website with Claude AI and what SEO steps are needed to get traffic.
- [Claude ทำ SEO ให้ได้จริงไหม](https://saralak-search.com/blog/ai-website-seo): Analysis of whether Claude can replace an SEO specialist, with real case evidence.

- [GEO Checklist สำหรับเว็บไซต์ไทย](https://saralak-search.com/blog/geo-checklist-thailand): 40-item GEO readiness checklist before AI cites your website.
- [llms.txt คืออะไร](https://saralak-search.com/blog/llms-txt-thailand): What llms.txt is and how to implement it for Thai websites.
